description: This file defines an AvatarLoader object responsible for loading user avatar images into ImageViews using the Glide library. It provides methods to load avatars based on account information and URLs, handling placeholder and error images, and applying circle crop transformations.

classes.name: AvatarLoader
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to load user avatar images into ImageViews.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an avatar image into an ImageView based on an Account object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an avatar image into an ImageView based on Account object and a username.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an avatar image into an ImageView using a provided URL or URL object.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the avatar image based on the base URL and username.
